capabilities: export the current file to TeX via a save dialog
copy the current file's TeX conversion to the clipboard
strip WikiLinks and resolve embeds during conversion
generate labels for headings and blocks and convert links to \ref calls
configure image path format and math environment handling
extras: README is thorough on commands and settings, with code examples for math exports and image paths, but no motivation section and no screenshots.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to turn notes into TeX source suitable for pasting into a LaTeX document.
summary: LaTeX export plugin that converts Obsidian notes to TeX, saving to file or copying to clipboard for pasting into TeX documents.
